sources.entry: Textus - WYSIWYG Markdown editor with math, tables, Mermaid and an optional AI writing assistant that works with cloud or local models. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/CatVinci-Studio/Textus) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Textus
summary.one_liner: Textus is a free, open-source, WYSIWYG Markdown editor for macOS, Windows and Linux with an optional built-in AI writing assistant.
use_cases: writing math and technical notes with equations
proofreading and polishing text with AI
private writing with a local model
exporting Markdown to PDF, Word or HTML
summary.what_it_does:
Textus is a Markdown editor that works in a WYSIWYG style and saves documents as plain .md files in a location the user chooses. It supports tables, task lists, footnotes, LaTeX-style math and Mermaid diagrams. Documents can be exported to PDF, Word, HTML and other formats. The optional writing assistant can check grammar, tighten, proofread, translate and adjust tone, and it works with more than 20 LLMs or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including Ollama for local models. The page says AI requests go directly from the device to the chosen provider, and API keys are stored locally.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Optional AI writing assistant that works with cloud providers or local models via Ollama
Plain .md files with tables, task lists, footnotes, math and Mermaid
No account, no tracking, no telemetry; API keys stored locally
caveats: AI features need the user's own provider account or API key, unless a local model is run with Ollama
iPhone and iPad versions are not yet available (coming soon)
